task.goal: Create the Q4 customer record, process its attachment, and upload the result to the web portal.
constraints: Use the existing signed-in browser session
Do not expose credentials or 2FA codes
success_criteria: The customer record is visible in the portal

planned_stages.description: Create the customer record in the browser portal
planned_stages.success_condition: The new customer record is visible in the portal
planned_stages.switch_condition: A native desktop dialog is required

planned_stages.description: Process the attachment in the native desktop application
planned_stages.success_condition: The processed file is saved and parses correctly
planned_stages.switch_condition: The browser can complete the operation without a native dialog

planned_stages.description: Upload the processed attachment and verify the result
planned_stages.success_condition: The portal shows the uploaded attachment
